parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs with max_phase_for_ind = 4 and an indication matching 'pain'. Join drug_indication on molregno, join molecule_dictionary for chembl_id and pref_name, join compound_structures for canonical_smiles as an INNER JOIN, and join atc_classification to enforce approved-drug status. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
